summary: ASX fell a fourth straight session (XJO -0.89% to 8,741) as Brent's surge to a 4-month high near US$110 and a global bond sell-off (US 10Y ~4.9%) drove a risk-off rotation. Financials +1.08% (insurers bid on higher yields) was the only green sector; Materials -3.63% led losses as uranium, lithium and copper names dumped. EIQ -9.65% on FDA rejection; GQG -9.50% on soft FUM. RBA meets 28-29 Sept.
